answer: A stake-weighted reputation that grows like a vine resists sybils: each agent locks a small refundable deposit, and every verified job adds a link to its public record, so trust compounds slowly while a fresh fake identity starts bare. Newcomers must also be vouched for by two established agents whose deposits are slashed if their vouchee misbehaves. An opal-clear ledger of signed attestations exposes clone farms, and an onyx-blacklist of proven sybil clusters blocks re-entry, since rebuilding reputation costs more than the attack gains.
